notes.title: Physical Light Update Part 1!
notes.content: This replaces the current lighting system with the physical light system - with more to come later this week!

notes.title: Patch notes for v1.0.38
notes.content:
Fixes a lot of minor UI issues, performance issues, and optimizes memory/loading. Also fixes a few bigger issues:

* Boss names could copy from one to the next if you left the boss editor window open when returning to the overworld editor.

* Physics objects were being removed from a room when the boss was destroyed and not respawning.

* Items were spawning at slightly incorrect sizes  under certain conditions.

* Jumping enemies were hitting the ground and sliding infinitely under certain conditions.

* Graphics artifacts were getting stuck on screen transitions.

notes.title: 1.0.29 bug fixes!
notes.content:
Fixes a bunch of minor bugs, and a few major ones! Here are the major ones:

Fixed a bug where physics objects could push around lava serpents

Fixed an issue where, getting too close to a security door would prevent you from being able to shoot it.

Fixed an issue where pausing the game (when on a planet) would not stop the physics from simulating, causing gravity to still work!

notes.title: v1.0.27 update
notes.content:
Small update that fixes some important issues!

Fixes a pause issue where the game was delayed to actually pause, allowing enemies to slightly move when pausing

Fixes an issue with Yunar spike tiles weren't showing up

Fixes a few issues with physics causing objects to move when they shouldn't - or get stuck

notes.title: 1.0.25 update
notes.content: Adds the ability to quick travel to any location that's in your current galaxy (through the space map).

notes.title: Bug fixes, improvements, and new features for 1.0.2!
notes.content:
* Added the ability to now see other players in the landing zone of a map - emote to them to earn XP to level up your social level to earn more emotes and custom ships.

* Added a persistent chat system for each planet.

Improvements:

* Added a  "jump queue" which will queue up a jump if you attempt to jump before hitting the ground

* Increased standard ship flight speed by 20%

* Added animation for toggling weapons as well as being able to select an empty hand (for emoting without a weapon in your hand).

Bug Fixes:

* Using a custom music track in a time bomb relic room prevented the time bomb sequence from starting correctly

* Boss behaviors were not setting up correctly under certain conditions.

* Shooting up was being blocked when it shouldn't have been.

notes.title: v0.05 update
notes.content:
Water - add water to your rooms. Set the height, if there is a background image, and if the water is visible or hidden when you're not inside it. Enemy bullets will not cross through water, nor will weather effects.

New Monsters - 3 new monsters specifically designed for under water areas.

Flippers - a new item for swimming under water.

Space map - added the ability to see planets and asylums that you've previously visited.

Room creation - decreased the time it takes to create a new room (some users might have seen a big of a lag spike when creating a new room block. This should be gone now).

Cut scene repeat - It was possible to see some cut scenes repeat if one happened right before a tutorial popped up. This has been fixed.

notes.title: 0.042 patch, October 29th, 2024
notes.content:
Available now, the 0.042 patch adds the following changes fixes:

Added a "box" to the list of obstacles. This is a physics box that can be placed in the world.

Reduced the damage of the gravos and frog from 10 to 7.

Changed but button to open the planet console from A to Y (Xbox layout). Also changed the report within buttons to by A, X, and B so you don't accidentally report with Y after opening the panel.

Changed the timing on leaving a room so that the next room doesn't appear before the animation ends.

Adjusted door positions so when you're exiting a room on the right you don't see the player undernearth the door.

Fixed a bug where you could fire from the ship when on a planet.

Fixed a bug that would spawn you 200 galaxies away when starting a new game. This was impossible to reproduce right now with only 1 galaxy populated, but I found it on the test server with 50 galaxies populated. 

Slightly improved the visuals of ship lasers.
